LESSON: CURVED MIRRORS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Curved mirrors
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 18

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Curved mirrors, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 INTEGRATED SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: How are curved mirrors used in day-to-day life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Curved mirrors together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: The learner exercises effective communication skills as they discuss and describe the characteristics of images formed

by curved mirrors in groups.

● Communication and Collaboration: The learner develops listening and writing skills while discussing in groups various types

of curved reflecting surfaces.

Values:
• Social justice: The learner enhances equity and accord equal opportunity to group members as they discuss and describe the

characteristics of images formed by curved mirrors in groups.

• Responsibility: The learner exercises excellence as they locate the position of images formed by concave and convex mirrors.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Safety and security: The learner observes personal safety and security while performing experiments to locate the position of the

image formed by concave and convex mirrors.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: How are curved mirrors used in day-to-day life?
